name: Compare the brands of many websites in one table (CSV) with MiroMiro

parameters.content:
## Compare the brands of many websites in one CSV with MiroMiro

### How it works
Compare the brands of many websites in one spreadsheet. Put the sites in **Set Website List**, one per line. **Extract Brand per Website** reads each one: brand colors with their roles, fonts, logo, and how sure MiroMiro is. **Build One Row per Website** turns every result into a row, and **Save as CSV Spreadsheet** saves the table as brands.csv for Excel or Google Sheets. `colors_from` says whether the colors were declared by the site or inferred from usage. A site that cannot be read gets a row with the reason in `error`, so the rest of the list still runs. Failed calls are not charged.

### Setup
This template uses the verified community node **n8n-nodes-miromiro** (tested with version 0.1.4 on n8n 1.123).
1. On n8n Cloud, search "MiroMiro" in the nodes panel (an admin may need to turn on Verified Community Nodes). Self-hosted: Settings > Community nodes > Install `n8n-nodes-miromiro`, see https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/
2. Get a free MiroMiro API key (300 credits a month, no card): https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding
3. Open **Extract Brand per Website** > Credential > Create new, and paste the key.
4. Put your websites in **Set Website List** and click **Execute workflow**.
5. Download brands.csv from **Save as CSV Spreadsheet**.

Each website costs 10 credits. The same site again within 24 hours is free.

### Customization
Read the list from Google Sheets and write the rows back with the Google Sheets node instead of a CSV. Run it on a Schedule trigger to see when a competitor changes its brand. Useful for competitor research and client pitches.

![The workflow, in case the preview does not load](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SoraiaBarroso/n8n-nodes-miromiro/main/docs/templates/compare-brands-csv.png)
